body:
I had a toe fungus, actually, I had ringworm over a good portion of my legs, but I had most of it taken care of.  Incredibly itchy.
I purchased some Salvia Divinorum to help with the irritation; I understand that many people find Salvia Divinorum uncomfortable and I have had Salvia Divinorum before; I felt that my parasite would also find the experience uncomfortable.
I took Salvia both orally and smoked a little of it.  I proceeded to take a shower and while in the shower, I did command the infected flesh of myself to leave my body; and while I watched my toes I saw small red globules that looked like flesh-blood march from my body and into the drain.  Later, my foot ringworm was completely gone.
It is no mistake, obvious experiences with this drug occur, and it was obvious to me to command my flesh free of disease while I took the Salvia Divinorum.  I probably would have tried to command my flesh either way, but because the Salvia Divinorum allows one mind to see what that one mind refuses to observe, I was also able to see the creation of my purging through, with my own senses, without the negatory experience of the inhibitive mind recurring my disease using the same creation power.
I have a very powerful mind, regardless, but the Salvia Divinorum helped, incredibly.
